text: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将全面夯实央行履职基础，持续优化金融基础设施和中央银行服务体系，提升中央银行金融服务质效，完善金融统计、支付、国库、现金服务体系。
text_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the PBOC will comprehensively consolidate the foundation for performing central bank duties, continuously optimize financial infrastructure and the central bank service system, improve the quality and efficiency of central bank financial services, and improve the financial statistics, payment, treasury, and cash service systems.
